channel.title: Valadisse Blog
channel.description: What evolves in adtech, and what it means for your inventory.

item.title: Buyers are buying from fewer places, and the shortlist is decided before the auction
item.description: ANA benchmark data shows buyers are shrinking their supply lists, and the cut happens before the auction. What it means for independent publishers.

item.title: Buying agents will soon read your ad products first
item.description: A new draft specification gives publishers a standard way to describe ad products so buying agents can read and compare them against a campaign brief. Inventory that an agent cannot read, verify, or price is unlikely to be part of that comparison.
